craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of vowed instruments; vyabhicāri utsāha at heart-and-speech enlisted. Sanskrit-first: evaitatstotum joint per UNC (kept joint — SD splits elsewhere, rejected); anatyakta (UNABANDONED — kept evermore-rush). Rows: 9 (heart/speaking-songs pair enlisted), 1 (‘evermore’ closes — rush-duration last). Close: ‘rush unabandoned, evermore’. Rupture: semicolon (form shines, then instruments vowed). Rejected: SD split — killed: joint kept; ‘abandoned-never’ reorder — killed: rush leads. Read aloud: VAR-ied, GIV-er, YOUR-form SHINES — OWN-por-tioned, THIS-world, DIFF-er-ence-FLED … TO-praise-IT, HEART and SPEAK-ing-SONGS be-MINE — RUSH un-a-BAN-doned, EV-er-MORE.

lines: Varied, giver, Your form shines — own-portioned, this world, difference fled;
to praise it, heart and speaking-songs be mine — rush unabandoned, evermore.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vividhaṃ te kila vapur vibhāti svāṃśe | tad evaitatstotuṃ hṛdayam atha gīrbāhyakaraṇaprabandhāś
